social.title: Celebrate Fiestas de Santa Fe on the Plaza
social.description: Join centuries-old street celebrations, mariachi sets, and candlelight processions that fill the Plaza for the oldest continuous community festival in the country.
social.bonus: Stay through at least one full mariachi set without checking your phone once.

social.title: Beer and Spirits Flight at Tumbleroot Brewery & Distillery
social.description: Split a table with friends and work through both a beer flight and a small-batch spirits tasting under one roof at this combined brewery-distillery.
social.bonus: Try the one spirit or beer on the menu you'd never normally order.

social.title: Small Plates and Mezcal at Julia's Social Club
social.description: Gather around a shared table of savory tapas and pass around a mezcal flight in a lively bar built for lingering conversation.
social.bonus: Let the table order for each other blind, no peeking at anyone else's dish before it's ordered.

social.title: Browse Booths at Santa Fe Indian Market on the Plaza
social.description: Weave through hundreds of booths circling the historic Plaza as more than a thousand Native artists from across the country sell jewelry, pottery, and textiles at the country's largest juried Native art market.
social.bonus: Buy one piece directly from the artist who made it and ask them to tell you the story behind it.

social.title: See a Performance Under the Stars at Santa Fe Opera
social.description: Settle into an open-air theater built into a mesa as world-class voices carry over the stage backdrop of the Jemez Mountains at sunset.
social.bonus: Grab a pre-show tailgate spot in the parking lot and share your picnic spread with the group parked next to you.

social.title: Pints on the Patio at Second Street Brewery Rufina Taproom
social.description: Grab a table on the sprawling dog-friendly patio near Meow Wolf and work through a flight of house-brewed ales with the after-work crowd.
social.bonus: Order the flight and rank all the beers out loud before your group tells you their picks.

social.title: Watch Old Man Gloom Burn at Zozobra
social.description: Join thousands packed into Fort Marcy Park chanting 'Burn him!' as a fifty-foot marionette effigy goes up in flames to torch away a year's worth of bad luck.
social.bonus: Write your own 'gloom' on a slip of paper ahead of time and toss it into the collection bins before the burn starts.

social.title: Taproom Hangout at Santa Fe Brewing Company
social.description: Post up at New Mexico's oldest craft brewery, cracking open a rotating lineup of ales alongside a lineup of live music and food trucks.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender which beer is newest on tap and be the first at your table to try it.

social.title: Sunset Cocktails at the Bell Tower Bar, La Fonda on the Plaza
social.description: Climb to a fifth-floor rooftop bar above the historic Plaza and watch the whole city turn gold as the sun drops behind the mountains.
social.bonus: Order the house margarita and stay until the very last sliver of sun disappears behind the hills.

social.title: Catch a Show at the Lensic Performing Arts Center
social.description: Settle into velvet seats inside a restored 1931 vaudeville palace downtown for anything from touring comedy to the New Mexico Jazz Festival.
social.bonus: Grab a drink at the lobby bar before the show and strike up a conversation with a stranger about what you're about to see.

foodie.title: Splurge Dinner at Geronimo
foodie.description: Settle into a candlelit 250-year-old adobe hacienda on Canyon Road for an elevated Southwestern tasting menu that's anchored Santa Fe fine dining for decades.
foodie.bonus: Order the tableside dessert if it's offered and let the whole table watch it get made.

foodie.title: Green Chile Cheeseburger at Tune-Up Café
foodie.description: Sink your teeth into a daily-ground beef patty topped with roasted green chile on a sesame brioche bun at the diner Food Network came looking for.
foodie.bonus: Pair it with a side of the Salvadoran pupusas to try two menus in one sitting.

foodie.title: Weekend Brunch at Cafe Pasqual's
foodie.description: Squeeze onto a communal bench under Mexican folk-art murals and dig into huevos motuleños or a green chile omelet at one of Santa Fe's most beloved breakfast spots.
foodie.bonus: Strike up a conversation with whoever ends up sharing your communal table.

foodie.title: Shared Plates and Wine at La Boca
foodie.description: Crowd around a small marble table and pass plates of Spanish-style tapas and sherry between friends inside a warm, lively downtown wine bar.
foodie.bonus: Let the sommelier pick your wine pairing instead of ordering your usual glass.

foodie.title: Hands-On Class at Santa Fe School of Cooking
foodie.description: Roll tamales and toast chile in a working teaching kitchen while a local chef breaks down the techniques behind real New Mexican cuisine.
foodie.bonus: Volunteer to hand-roll the first tamale of the class instead of waiting to watch someone else do it first.

foodie.title: Robatayaki Dinner at Izanami, Ten Thousand Waves
foodie.description: Grill skewers over an open robata fire and share small izakaya plates on a candlelit patio tucked into the pines above the famous spa.
foodie.bonus: Order one dish you can't pronounce off the menu without asking your server to translate first.

foodie.title: Test Your Limits at Horseman's Haven
foodie.description: Order the green chile smothered burger at a no-frills diner behind a gas station that locals have sworn by for fiery, addictive chile since 1981.
foodie.bonus: Finish the whole plate of green chile without reaching for your water glass more than twice.

foodie.title: Craft Spirits Flight at Santa Fe Spirits Distillery
foodie.description: Taste a flight of locally distilled gin, single malt whiskey, and the world's only piñon-nut liqueur straight from the stills that make them.
foodie.bonus: Guess the barrel-aging time of the whiskey before the bartender tells you the real number.

foodie.title: Order Chile 'Christmas Style' at The Shed
foodie.description: Squeeze into a centuries-old adobe hacienda near the Plaza and pile blue-corn tortillas high with the restaurant's legendary red and green chile combo.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server which chile is hotter that week and order accordingly instead of playing it safe.

foodie.title: Sip Aztec Elixirs at Kakawa Chocolate House
foodie.description: Order a historic-recipe drinking chocolate spiced with chile and cinnamon at a tiny shop devoted entirely to pre-Columbian and colonial-era chocolate elixirs.
foodie.bonus: Order the spiciest elixir on the menu and see how far you get before reaching for water.

foodie.title: Saturday Morning at Santa Fe Farmers Market
foodie.description: Wander open-air stalls at the Railyard piled with New Mexico chile ristras, heirloom produce, and fresh-baked bread straight from the growers who made them.
foodie.bonus: Buy one ingredient you've never cooked with before and figure out a recipe for it later.

foodie.title: Green Chile Enchiladas at Tomasita's
foodie.description: Dig into stacked blue-corn enchiladas smothered in decades-refined green chile inside a converted rail depot that's been slinging New Mexican food since the 1970s.
foodie.bonus: Order it Christmas style, red and green chile both, and pick a favorite before the plate's clean.

adventure.title: Hike Chimney Rock at Ghost Ranch, Georgia O'Keeffe's High Desert
adventure.description: Climb a switchback trail to a red-rock spire overlooking the Piedra Lumbre basin that inspired decades of O'Keeffe's paintings.
adventure.bonus: Frame a photo from the exact overlook O'Keeffe painted and try to match her color palette in real life.

adventure.title: Whitewater Rafting the Rio Grande with Santa Fe Rafting
adventure.description: Paddle through the churning Class III rapids of the Rio Grande's Racecourse section with the canyon walls rising steep on either side.
adventure.bonus: Volunteer for the front row seat and take the biggest wave face-on without dropping your paddle.

adventure.title: Power Up Sun Mountain Trail's Switchbacks
adventure.description: Charge up a short, steep two-mile out-and-back climb straight off the Old Santa Fe Trail to a sweeping overlook of the entire city.
adventure.bonus: Time your ascent and try to beat it on the way back down without running.

adventure.title: Mountain Bike La Tierra Trails on a Rental Hardtail
adventure.description: Rent a hardtail and rail wide, sandy singletrack through high-desert scrub across 25 miles of beginner-to-intermediate mountain bike trails.
adventure.bonus: Ride the full Yucca Trail loop without putting a foot down once.

adventure.title: Horseback Trail Ride Through Cerrillos Hills with Broken Saddle
adventure.description: Trot a sure-footed horse through pinon-studded canyons and old turquoise mining hills where the trail winds past hidden overlooks.
adventure.bonus: Get your horse into a trot for at least one full stretch of trail, not just a walk.

adventure.title: Paddle Cochiti Lake at the Foot of the Jemez Mountains
adventure.description: Launch a kayak or paddleboard onto Cochiti Lake's glassy no-wake water with red mesas and volcanic peaks framing every direction.
adventure.bonus: Paddle out until downtown noise completely disappears, then just float and listen for five full minutes.

adventure.title: Summit Atalaya Mountain from the Atalaya Trailhead
adventure.description: Grind up a steep, switchbacking trail from St. John's College to a 9,121-foot summit with a full sweep of Santa Fe spread out below.
adventure.bonus: Reach the summit cairn and identify at least three named peaks in the Sangre de Cristo range from the top.

adventure.title: Run or Walk the Santa Fe River Trail
adventure.description: Jog a shaded, mostly paved greenway that traces the Santa Fe River from the historic Plaza out through quiet cottonwood-lined neighborhoods.
adventure.bonus: Pick a turnaround point you've never reached before and push just a little past it.

adventure.title: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Flight with Santa Fe Balloons
adventure.description: Lift off before dawn and drift silently over sagebrush mesas and the Rio Grande as the Sangre de Cristo Mountains catch the first light.
adventure.bonus: Toast the landing with the traditional champagne toast and learn the balloonist's blessing before you land.

adventure.title: Turquoise Trail Road Trip to the Mine Shaft Tavern in Madrid
adventure.description: Cruise the winding Turquoise Trail past old coal-mining hills into the reborn ghost town of Madrid, then swing open the saloon doors of the Mine Shaft Tavern.
adventure.bonus: Order the green chile cheeseburger and rank it against every other green chile burger you've had in Santa Fe.

adventure.title: Hike and Picnic at Hyde Memorial State Park
adventure.description: Wander pine-and-aspen trails at 8,500 feet in New Mexico's oldest state park, then spread out a picnic at a table tucked in the forest.
adventure.bonus: Hike the full Bear Wallow loop instead of sticking to the short Girl Scout Trail.

adventure.title: Bouldering Session at Santa Fe Climbing Center
adventure.description: Chalk up and work a bouldering wall or top-rope route inside Northern New Mexico's only dedicated indoor climbing gym.
adventure.bonus: Send one route a full grade harder than what you'd normally attempt, even if you fall trying.

adventure.title: Get Lost Inside Meow Wolf's House of Eternal Return
adventure.description: Crawl through a refrigerator portal into a maze of glowing, physics-defying rooms built by hundreds of artists inside a converted bowling alley.
adventure.bonus: Find the hidden room behind the fireplace before checking your phone for a map or hint.

adventure.title: Dark-Sky Telescope Tour with Astronomy Adventures
adventure.description: Drive to a private dark-sky site outside city lights and peer through a professional telescope while a guide traces constellations across a sky thick with stars.
adventure.bonus: Find Saturn's rings through the eyepiece and snap a blurry photo through the lens to send to a skeptical friend.

adventure.title: Ride the Sky Railway Stargazer Train into the Galisteo Basin
adventure.description: Roll out of the Santa Fe rail yard on a vintage train car and clatter into the dark Galisteo Basin as live musicians play and champagne pours under a blazing Milky Way.
adventure.bonus: Spot the Milky Way's core with your naked eye before the onboard guide points it out over the speaker.

adventure.title: Sunset Walk to the Cross of the Martyrs
adventure.description: Climb a short paved path up a hill above downtown to a hilltop cross with a wide-open view of the city catching the last orange light.
adventure.bonus: Time your arrival at the top to the exact minute the sun drops behind the western hills.

adventure.title: Guided Tour of the Puye Cliff Dwellings on Santa Clara Pueblo Land
adventure.description: Follow a tribal guide up cliffside ladders into centuries-old cave homes carved into volcanic mesa walls above the Rio Grande valley.
adventure.bonus: Climb the full cliff-face ladder route to the mesa-top ruins instead of taking the easier bottom-loop tour.

adventure.title: Climb Ancient Ladders at Bandelier National Monument
adventure.description: Scramble up wooden ladders into 800-year-old cave dwellings carved into volcanic tuff along a canyon trail lined with ponderosa pines.
adventure.bonus: Climb into the Alcove House kiva 140 feet up via four wooden ladders and sit inside the reconstructed ceremonial room.

adventure.title: Swim Laps and Skate at Genoveva Chavez Community Center
adventure.description: Split an afternoon between the Olympic-size lap pool and the NHL-size ice arena inside Santa Fe's massive community recreation center.
adventure.bonus: Do both the pool and the ice rink in the same visit, not just one.

adventure.title: Saturday Bird Walk at Randall Davey Audubon Center
adventure.description: Wander a 135-acre canyon sanctuary with a volunteer naturalist, scanning feeders and ponderosa groves for any of the 190-plus recorded bird species.
adventure.bonus: Spot and correctly name three bird species before the guide identifies them for the group.

adventure.title: Hike the Dale Ball Trails Foothills Loop
adventure.description: Wind through 24 miles of piñon-juniper singletrack in the foothills of the Sangre de Cristos with panoramic views of the city below.
adventure.bonus: Take a junction you've never taken before and pick your way back using only the trail signage.

adventure.title: Guided E-Bike Ride on La Tierra Trails with Santa Fe Mountain Bike Tours
adventure.description: Rip through sandy singletrack and desert arroyos on a guided e-bike ride, catching air on the Trash Pit's beginner jump lines along the way.
adventure.bonus: Clear the smallest jump line in the Trash Pit without unclipping your feet.

adventure.title: Downhill Ski or Snowboard Day at Ski Santa Fe
adventure.description: Carve high-elevation powder runs down 12,075-foot Tesuque Peak, one of the highest ski areas in the country, just twenty minutes from downtown.
adventure.bonus: Ski or ride a run you've never done before, even if it bumps you up a difficulty level.

adventure.title: Horseback Ride at The Stables at Bishop's Lodge
adventure.description: Saddle up with an experienced wrangler and wind through the piñon-covered foothills just above the historic Bishop's Lodge property.
adventure.bonus: Ask your wrangler for the ranch's history and repeat one story back to your group afterward.

chill.title: Sit Quietly Inside the Cathedral Basilica of St. Francis
chill.description: Step under the soaring stone arches of Santa Fe's Romanesque cathedral, built by Archbishop Lamy around the walls of an even older adobe chapel.
chill.bonus: Find the small La Conquistadora chapel tucked off to the side and learn its centuries-old story.

chill.title: Find the Miraculous Staircase at Loretto Chapel
chill.description: Step into a tiny Gothic chapel modeled on Sainte-Chapelle to see the mysterious spiral staircase built with no visible nails or center support.
chill.bonus: Count the staircase's two full 360-degree turns yourself before reading the plaque's explanation.

chill.title: Stroll the Santa Fe Botanical Garden at Museum Hill
chill.description: Wander a high-desert garden of xeric plantings, rock channels, and a piñon-juniper woodland left almost entirely wild for fourteen quiet acres.
chill.bonus: Find the traditional adobe horno ovens in the Horno Plaza and learn how they were used.

chill.title: Wander the Georgia O'Keeffe Museum
chill.description: Move slowly through gallery after gallery of bone-white skulls, red hills, and giant blooms that trace one artist's entire evolving vision of the Southwest.
chill.bonus: Pick the one painting you'd steal if you could, and be ready to defend your choice.

chill.title: Take In New Media at Vladem Contemporary
chill.description: Move through repurposed warehouse galleries in the Railyard Arts District filled with contemporary sculpture, glass, and video art made since 1970.
chill.bonus: Sit through one full video art piece from start to finish instead of walking past it.

chill.title: Shop the Native Artisans' Portal at Palace of the Governors
chill.description: Browse hand-strung turquoise and hand-stamped silver laid out on blankets under the portal of a 1610 adobe palace by the artists who made every piece.
chill.bonus: Ask one artisan how they made their favorite piece on the blanket and listen to the whole answer.

chill.title: Day Pass Soak at Ojo Santa Fe Spa Resort
chill.description: Sink into a chain of warm mineral and saltwater soaking pools set along a quiet arroyo just southwest of the city, with zero agenda for the whole afternoon.
chill.bonus: Cycle through every pool temperature at least once before picking a favorite to settle into.

chill.title: Gallery-Hop Down Canyon Road
chill.description: Drift from adobe gallery to adobe gallery along a mile of century-old art row, ducking into sculpture gardens and sunlit courtyards the whole way.
chill.bonus: Walk into the gallery with the art you're least sure you understand and ask the staff to explain one piece.

chill.title: See Contemporary Indigenous Art at IAIA's MoCNA
chill.description: Walk through the only U.S. museum devoted entirely to contemporary Indigenous art, housed in a converted federal post office downtown.
chill.bonus: Pick the piece that most surprises your expectations of what 'Native art' looks like.

chill.title: Visit San Miguel Chapel, the Oldest Church in the Country
chill.description: Duck into a squat adobe sanctuary built in the early 1600s, its thick walls and worn wooden altar still standing exactly where they were first raised.
chill.bonus: Find and read the original 1600s bell inscription before checking what it says online.

chill.title: Soak in the Communal Tubs at Ten Thousand Waves
chill.description: Slip into a steaming Japanese-style hot tub tucked into the pines above the city and let a shiatsu massage finish the job of unwinding completely.
chill.bonus: Do the full cold-plunge-then-hot-tub cycle at least twice before you towel off for good.

chill.title: Explore Native Heritage at the Museum of Indian Arts and Culture
chill.description: Move through galleries of Pueblo pottery, Navajo weaving, and Apache beadwork that trace thousands of years of Southwest Indigenous life on Museum Hill.
chill.bonus: Find one object made within the last twenty years and one made centuries ago, and compare the techniques.
